mapper.select: SELECT id, urged_at FROM application_urge_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND round_no=#{roundNo} ORDER BY urged_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_urge_record (id, tenant_id, application_id, round_no, urged_by, note, urged_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{applicationId}, #{roundNo}, #{urgedBy}, #{note}, #{urgedAt})
